h1: Barcelona Premium Walnut Wall Clock by Nomon
description:
The Nomon Barcelona Premium is a walnut wall clock: the box is walnut, the hands are walnut and polished brass, and the double fiberglass bezel has a polished brass finish.

TWO RING FINISHES

  • Walnut box with walnut and polished brass hands.
  • Fiberglass rings in black or in brass.
  • German UTS movement available as an option.

SIZE ON THE WALL

At Ø35 3/8" x 40 1/2" H x 7" D, this Nomon wall clock is a large piece, so measure the free wall before you order. Compare it with other wall clocks if your wall is smaller.

h1: Dandy Leather Pool Table by Vismara
description:
The Dandy is a Vismara pool table designed by Vismara e Bellavista & Piccini, with the whole structure and the pockets covered in leather. The top is Lavagna slate covered in Simonis wool and cotton cloth. Made in Italy.

A PROFESSIONAL SURFACE

The slate keeps the bed flat and balanced for American pool. The upper part of the sides comes in Noce canaletto or Ebony Makassar veneer, and the leather pool table is offered in glossy, matt or soft touch versions.

THREE SIZES

Choose 7, 8 or 9 feet; the largest is 115" W x 66 1/2" D x 31 5/8" H. Leave room for the cue on every side. See all pool tables.

h1: Palatial Elegance Gold Leaf Side Table by Modenese
description:
The Palatial Elegance is a traditional side table by Modenese, with a carved frame and curved legs finished with gold leaf detailing. Made in Italy.

THIS VERSION: WOOD TOP

This listing is the version without a marble top: the top is wood, matching the structure, so the whole piece reads as one wood table. If you want the marble top, check the version before you order.

BESIDE A SOFA

At 23 5/8" W x 23 5/8" D x 22 1/4" H, this gold leaf side table fits next to a sofa or an armchair. See more side tables.

h1: Ciclotte Glossy Glass Disc Exercise Bike by Teckell
description:
The Teckell Ciclotte Glossy is an indoor exercise bike built around a 1 1/8" multi-layer glass disc, tempered outside and hardened within, on a polished stainless steel base. Made in Italy.

HOW IT RIDES

  • 12-magnet flywheel with electronic resistance and 10 levels.
  • 6 cm pedal distance, to protect the joints.
  • Handlebar in carbon fiber or hand-painted finish; handlebar and gel seat adjust in height and tilt.
  • Bluetooth for Android and iOS fitness apps.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

It comes with the Teckell Tool Kit and a Certificate of Authenticity; the device stand is optional. Plan for 43 3/4" W x 19 5/8" D x 43 3/4" H. Indoor use only. See all cardio equipment.

description:
The Tratto is a wall lamp by Kundalini, designed by Oliver Schick, with a metal structure and an opal glass diffuser. Made in Italy.

ONE OR SEVERAL

Its linear profile stands out from the wall and draws a line of light and shadow. Install one on its own, or repeat it along a wall to build a composition; it works in homes and in contract projects.

ONE SIZE

This glass wall sconce comes in one size, Ø10 5/8" x 11 3/8" H. If you plan a row, decide the spacing before you order. Compare other wall sconces.

h1: George Rope Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
description:
The Talenti George is a two-seater outdoor sofa by Ludovica + Roberto Palomba. Its stainless steel structure is fully covered in a slightly padded rope weave, with a nautical feel. Made in Italy.

BUILT FOR OUTDOORS

  • Generously padded seat and back cushions.
  • Removable covers, easy to wash and resistant to the weather.
  • Three color combinations.

A LOW, COMPACT SEAT

At 69 5/8" W with a 15 5/8" seat height, this rope sofa seats two and sits low for lounging. As a Talenti sofa, it belongs to a collection with sectionals, low tables and lounge chairs. See all outdoor sofas.

h1: Paloma Active Freestanding Speakers by Vismara
description:
Paloma Speakers are active, freestanding luxury speakers by Vismara, designed by Studio Boccaccio 432. Each one pairs a dome tweeter and a ribbon tweeter with two woofers, and a subwoofer housed in the cone base.

WHAT THEY NEED

They extend the Paloma integrated and modular Sound System. An integrated amplifier makes them an active system and is required for them to work.

TWO CONE BASES

Choose a hand-painted gradient cone base or a lacquered one. Each speaker is 70 7/8" H on a 15 7/8" W x 15 7/8" D footprint, so place them by the scale of the room. See more accessories.

description:

description:
Luceplan Mesh is an LED ceiling light designed by Francisco Gomez Paz. Its 96 LED points sit at the intersections of a light, almost transparent network of flexible cables.
